title: Picture 1: Gardening together
beschreibung: What are these people doing together? What tools are they using?
Who do you think these people are? Why are they working together?
persoenlich: Have you got a garden or a balcony? What do you grow there?
Do you like working with plants? Why, or why not?
Do you like doing jobs together with other people? Which jobs?
In your country, do many people have a garden? What is it like there?
imageNeeded: Several people working together in a garden or a community vegetable bed, with a spade and a watering can. Daylight.

title: Picture 2: People on a bus
beschreibung: Describe how the people are sitting. What do they look like?
What is this picture about? How do the people look: tired, bored, happy?
persoenlich: Do you often go by bus or metro? How long is your journey? How do you feel on the way?
Is a long journey tiring for you? Why?
How do you get to work or to your Spanish class?
What do you like doing on a long journey?
imageNeeded: Passengers on a bus or a train, tired, some looking out of the window or at their phones.
imageQuery: tired passengers bus public transport commute

title: Picture 3: A young man and an older woman
beschreibung: ¿Qué está pasando aquí? ¿Qué relación crees que tienen estas dos personas?
¿Dónde podría ser? Describe el lugar y la época del año.
persoenlich: ¿Ayudas a personas que no conoces en el autobús o en el metro? ¿Cedes el asiento?
¿Es importante ayudar a las personas mayores? ¿Por qué?
En tu país, ¿cómo muestran los jóvenes su respeto a los mayores?
¿Alguna vez has ayudado a alguien recién llegado a tu ciudad? ¿Qué pasó?
imageNeeded: A younger person holding an older person's arm as they walk along together. Daylight.
imageQuery: young man helping senior woman walk holding arm
